node.title: Re: Filtering out stop words
node.author: Eily
node.doctext: If you're searching for an exact match you might as well use a hash: my $commonWords = {}; # Make commonWords a ref to an empty hash ... while (my $line = <>) { chomp($line); $commonWords->{$line} = 1; } ... if ($CkDiscardCommonwords eq 1) { return(0) if exists $commonWords->{$term}; } I suppose you extracted the code from your script and that's why you have a [doc://return] outside of a function?
